items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Benny Frenchy? [INTERVIEWER] Benny Frenchy used to play with Handy

ctx.x: That was on Raven Avenue, just between Beale and Lennon on Raven Used to call it Hatton's Avenue long years back Used to be a gang of sporting people hanging around there and piano would be running night and day playing all kinds of blues Handy's blues, St. Louis blues, Memphis blues, Yellow Dog All city blues like that was out then, all Bauhaus music
Benny Frenchy used to play with Handy
